text:
maria_support: Hey team — AcmeCorp says their promo code showed as accepted in the UI but their account balance is still 0. They provided the redemption email and a screenshot. Org ID: org_0aBc123, promo: SPRING50. Can someone look up the ledger entry?

alex_m: Thanks — can you paste the redemption id or webhook id from the email? Also which env (prod/staging)?

maria_support: Prod. Redemption ID from email: redeem_20260301_8943. Screenshot attached in thread. Customer reports they clicked Redeem -> confirmation modal -> "Applied". No change in billing dashboard.

ledger-bot: Webhook received: {"id":"redeem_20260301_8943","org":"ORG_0abc123","amount":50000,"status":"acknowledged","ts":"2026-03-01T18:22:10Z"} (ingest-service v2.4.1)

sam_ops: Looking at ledger ingestion. Quick check: failed mapping from external org id to internal org UUID due to case mismatch. Ingest created event with org_key "ORG_0abc123" but our ledger row expects lowercased keys.

billing_oncall: If that's the case we should not do a blind SQL update without approvals. Maria — can we confirm customer org internal id and whether any other grants were applied today?

maria_support: Internal org_id: 78f3b9d2-11a2-4c9a-9f3b-2d5c5a9f6e2a. No other grants in the last 7 days per dashboard. Customer on a free-trial, expects 50k token credit.

alex_m: Repro steps I want to run locally: 1) simulate webhook payload with org key case-variance 2) run ingest to see mapping 3) check ledger table `promo_redemptions` for redeem_20260301_8943. Can someone share the exact SELECT?

sam_ops: SELECT * FROM promo_redemptions WHERE redemption_id = 'redeem_20260301_8943';

sam_ops: Output (sanitized):
```
redemption_id | org_key     | amount | applied_to_org | status     | created_at
redeem_20260301_8943 | ORG_0abc123 | 50000  | NULL           | acknowledged | 2026-03-01 18:22:10
```

sam_ops: We see `applied_to_org` is NULL. That explains 0 balance. The webhook was acked but mapping failed.

billing_oncall: Ok. Fix options: 1) re-run mapping job for this event 2) manually apply a grant to the internal org (create `account_credits` row) and mark redemption as applied. Option 2 is quicker for single-customer but needs audit note.

alex_m: I'll pref the safe route: backfill mapping script for the single redeem event and then run the ledger apply job. Sam, can you run the mapping re-run with a note? Use `ingest-service reprocess --redemption redeem_20260301_8943 --reason "case-mismatch backfill"`

sam_ops: Running now.

ledger-bot: Reprocess job queued: job_88571. Reprocess started by sam_ops at 2026-03-01T19:01:02Z.

sam_ops: Reprocess finished. Mapping succeeded. promo_redemptions row updated: applied_to_org = '78f3b9d2-11a2-4c9a-9f3b-2d5c5a9f6e2a', status = 'applied', applied_at = '2026-03-01T19:02:15Z'.

sam_ops: Triggering ledger-apply job to credit account. Command used: `ledger-apply --redemption redeem_20260301_8943 --executor sam_ops --audit "support: AcmeCorp redeem fix"`

ledger-bot: Ledger apply succeeded. New account_credits row created id=ac_20260301_997, amount=50000, org=78f3b9d2-11a2-4c9a-9f3b-2d5c5a9f6e2a.

billing_oncall: I'll add a billing audit entry and notify CS to confirm with customer once they see balance. Note: opened internal ticket BI-3421 for a systemic fix to lower-case normalize org keys during ingest.

maria_support: Notified the customer and asked them to refresh the billing dashboard. They replied: "Balance shows 50k — thank you!" :white_check_mark:

alex_m: Great. Can we add a small unit test to ingest-service to catch case-variant org keys? Also add an alert if `applied_to_org` stays NULL for > 15 minutes after acknowledged. Filing infra work item INF-881.

sam_ops: Will file the PR for the ingest fix and the alert.

maria_support: Closing the support thread with customer confirmation. Thanks everyone.

sre_jun: Quick note for the incident log: root cause = org id case-sensitivity during webhook mapping. Mitigation = reprocess and ledger-apply backfill. Next step = normalize org keys in ingest and add metric to detect un-applied redemptions.

maria_support: Marking resolved. "Customer confirmed credits applied".
